package handler

import (
	bots "GENRE_MODULE/loadtest"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"
	"context"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/runner"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func completeScenarioRobot(t *testing.T, f *scenarioFixture, addr string) {
	t.Helper()
	run := func(token string, steps ...bots.Step) {
		t.Helper()
		r := bots.Commands(runner.Config{Count: 1, Duration: 5 * time.Second, Transport: transport.Config{Endpoint: addr}}, func(*robot.Context) (*transport.Packet, error) { return transport.AuthPacket(token), nil }, steps)
		if err := r.Run(context.Background()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if s := r.Stats(); s.Success != 1 || s.Failure != 0 || s.Canceled != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("robot: %+v", s)
		}
	}

	help := pb.ScenarioCommandRequest{RoomID: f.room.ID(), Seq: 1, Revision: 1, Kind: "help"}
	run("fixture-peer", bots.Step{Request: help, Revision: 2}, bots.Step{Request: help, Revision: 2, Reconnect: true})
	harvest := pb.ScenarioCommandRequest{RoomID: f.room.ID(), Seq: 2, Revision: 2, Kind: "harvest"}
	run("fixture-peer", bots.Step{Request: harvest, WantCode: 1})
	run("fixture-outsider", bots.Step{Request: harvest, WantCode: 1})
	run("fixture-owner", bots.Step{Request: harvest, WantCode: 1})
	f.now.Store(f.state(t).ReadyAt)
	run("fixture-owner", bots.Step{Request: harvest, Revision: 3, Reward: 5}, bots.Step{Request: harvest, Revision: 3, Reward: 5, Reconnect: true})
	if s := f.state(t); s.Planted || s.Harvests != 1 || s.Revision != 3 || robotRead(t, f.engine, f.players[0], func() int64 { return f.players[0].Dao().GetCoins() }) != 5 || robotRead(t, f.engine, f.players[1], func() int64 { return f.players[1].Dao().GetCoins() }) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("production/help/harvest ownership or reward mismatch")
	}
}
